corpus.hash_scope: ordered IDs, index, pages, normalized text, little-endian float32 vectors

exact_match_slice.definition: Answerable questions mentioning an explicit acronym, GPT model, named QA benchmark, or numbered table. Frozen before Phase5 hybrid/reranker measurements.

method.sql_timing: client-observed SQL roundtrip plus ORM hydration; no embedding
method.memory_scope: benchmark worker RSS only; database/server/container RAM unmeasured
method.memory_baseline: warm BGE and dense SQL, before cold reranker load
method.units: decimal bytes; gains in percentage points
